value.rationale: The unit-length metric graph of a complete biclique is a canonical family, and the natural full two-point intrinsic distance law gives both two-moment isometry reconstruction and a sharp measure-dependent reversal of stochastic order as graphs balance. The linear/quadratic near-diameter transition also distinguishes cyclic versus tree members. This is structural and all-order, not an arbitrary small table or isolated known star mean.
